title: Emm raises $9M seed to create one of the world’s first ‘smart’ menstrual cups
summary: On Wednesday, Emm, based in the UK, announced a $9 million seed (£6.8 million) round led by Lunar Ventures as it prepares to officially launch the smart menstrual cup in 2026.
